text:
Congratulations to Santa Clarita Mayor Pro Tem Patsy Ayala for being sworn onto the @MetroLosAngeles Board! 

For the first time, Northern LA County will have a voice on a board responsible for billions in transportation investments. These decisions directly impact how people across our region get to work, school, and home.
